bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
root=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
file="$root/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
candidate=$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:room-fix-a42be37) || exit 44
old=$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1) || exit 43
test "$old" != "$candidate" || exit 45
current_hash=$(docker inspect --format '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.config-hash"}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)
expected_hash=$(docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" config --hash gaybbs | awk '{print $NF}')
test "$current_hash" = "$expected_hash" || exit 46
docker image tag "$old" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-room-a42be37 || exit 47
docker image tag "$candidate" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 48
failure=63
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1; then failure=61
else
 i=0
 while test "$i" -lt 15; do
  if test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != "$candidate" || test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null)" != true; then failure=62; break; fi
  if docker logs --since 2m deploy-gaybbs-1 2>&1 | grep -q 'GAYBBS_BOT_READY bot_id=8872855519'; then
   test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.RestartCount}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = 0 && { echo ROOM_LIVE_DEPLOY_PASS; exit 0; }
   failure=64; break
  fi
  i=$((i+1)); sleep 3
 done
fi
docker image tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-room-a42be37 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local || exit 70
docker compose -p deploy -f "$file" --project-directory "$root/deploy" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 71
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = "$old" && test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 72
exit "$failure"
